summary: Comprehensive backend testing of FakturaFlow MVP. All 25 tests passed (100%) covering auth (register/login/logout/me), Clients CRUD, Invoices CRUD with totals math + PDF generation + duplicate, Expenses CRUD, Groq AI (OCR receipt, generate-concept, financial-summary), Dashboard aggregations, Quarterly/Annual reports, Fiscal calendar (Modelos 303/130/111/390/etc), Settings GET/PUT, Global search, and per-user data scoping.

minor.issue: Sets cookies with samesite='none'+secure=true. Works over HTTPS preview URL but will fail over plain HTTP local dev. Acceptable for the deployed env.
iva_sop computation uses e.amount * iva/(100+iva) which assumes amount is gross; if user enters net amount the IVA will be undercounted. Document the convention.
Uses today.replace(day=1) - timedelta(days=k*30) which is approximate; near month boundaries the same month can repeat or skip. Consider using dateutil.relativedelta.
Invoice number generator is not transactionally safe (read settings, increment, update). Concurrent creates could produce duplicate numbers. Use $inc atomic op.

allow_origins=['*'] together with allow_credentials=True is invalid per spec; FastAPI/Starlette will reflect origin via allow_origin_regex='.*' so it works, but tightening to explicit origins is recommended.
No brute-force lockout/rate limiting (playbook recommends lockout after 5 fails).

action_items: Optional: Replace next-number generation with atomic $inc to avoid race condition on invoice numbering.
Optional: Add brute-force lockout for /api/auth/login (per auth playbook).
Optional: Tighten CORS to explicit allowed origins instead of '*' with credentials.
Optional: Use dateutil.relativedelta for accurate monthly buckets in /api/dashboard.
critical_code_review_comments: Invoice number generation has a race condition (read-then-write). Use db.settings.find_one_and_update with $inc on next_number.<series>.
samesite='none' cookies require HTTPS, which is fine for the deployed preview but breaks local HTTP testing — document this.
Dashboard 'mark as vencida' loop performs N update_one calls on every request; consider a single update_many or batching for performance.
calculate_invoice_totals correctly handles quantity, price, discount, iva, irpf — verified: 2x100 with 21% IVA and 15% IRPF -> subtotal 200, IVA 42, IRPF 30, total 212.
server.py is 760 lines — consider splitting routers (auth/clients/invoices/ai/reports) into modules for maintainability.
test_credentials: Tests register fresh users test_a_<uuid>@fakturaflow.es / TestPass123! (admin@fakturaflow.es is documented but NOT seeded). The seed-admin playbook is not implemented in server.py.
seed_data_creation: Each test run registers two unique throwaway users; created clients/invoices/expenses are deleted by test_zz_delete. No admin seeding is performed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL works fully. Cookie-based JWT auth with httpOnly + secure + samesite=none. Run pytest backend/tests/test_fakturaflow.py. The fixture _login_or_register handles repeat runs (re-uses existing user). Groq vision model meta-llama/llama-4-scout-17b-16e-instruct works for OCR. admin@fakturaflow.es is documented in test_credentials.md but is NOT actually seeded in DB — register a new user instead.
